resources.string: SandFly 0.3.0 has the new features on the following pages. To read them again later, open New features in SandFly at the top of SandFly settings.

With a physical keyboard, choose the SandFly, VoiceOver, NVDA, JAWS or Orca keymap under Settings, Keyboard shortcuts, Choose a keymap, and the SandFly key it uses. In the NVDA, JAWS and Orca keymaps, the arrow keys and Tab move without the SandFly key, and there are object navigation, a review cursor and Recognise text on screen. The browse mode shortcut can be changed, also to the SandFly key pressed twice.

Gesture profiles, under Settings, Gestures, give gestures other commands, and Next gesture profile switches between them. Gestures in apps and Keyboard shortcuts in apps give gestures and keys other commands in chosen apps. Each one-finger swipe also has a swipe and hold: swipe, rest the finger, then lift.

The speech dictionary, under Settings, Speech, says chosen text differently in all speech. Let other apps speak lets apps, and the current keyboard, speak through SandFly. The clipboard history keeps what you copy, and with Shizuku also what you copy in other apps.

Type an app\'s name in braille to open it is a command that makes the screen a braille keyboard for the start of an app\'s name. Japanese is a new braille language. The braille keyboard is hidden while a physical keyboard is connected.

Submit text, Turn magnification on or off, Rewind, Fast forward and Accessibility shortcuts can be assigned under Settings, Commands. Use SandFly as the wallpaper, under Settings, Display, keeps SandFly running on phones whose battery savers stop it. Reset accessibility audio after calls, under Settings, Audio output, moves speech off the earpiece after a call.

Scripts can now touch the screen, press keys, run SandFly commands, open windows, recognise text, and speak during calls. Before installing a script, SandFly shows where it came from and whether SandFly signed it.

SandFly Pro recognises buttons, text and other elements that apps and games draw without exposing them, and shows them as items to swipe to and double tap. Choose Recognise screen in the SandFly menu, or turn on screen recognition for an app in the SandFly menu or under Settings, SandFly Pro, Automatic screen recognition.
